familyGenRules.reasoning: HPE CLIC Rule 81354652: When ordering Smart Storage Hybrid Capacitor P02377-B21 or Smart Storage Battery P01366-B21, P48918-B21 (Storage Controller Enablement Cable Kit) must be ordered to provide the power link.
familyGenRules.rawMessage: [CLIC RULE 81354652] When ordering P52534-B21 with P02377-B21 0D1 / P01366-B21 0D1 then P48918-B21 0D1 must be ordered.

familyGenRules.ruleUpdate: P51911-B21 and P48830-B21 cannot be selected together. Retain P48830-B21.
familyGenRules.reasoning: HPE CLIC Rule 81355854: P51911-B21 (CPU1 to OCP2) and P48830-B21 (CPU2 to OCP2) are mutually exclusive and cannot be selected together. Retain P48830-B21 for dual-socket PCIe balance.
familyGenRules.rawMessage: [CLIC RULE 81355854] P51911-B21 and P48830-B21 are mutually exclusive.

familyGenRules.ruleUpdate: When 5+ PCIe cards are installed, P56073-B21 Primary Cable Kit is mandatory for Primary Riser Slot 1.
familyGenRules.reasoning: HPE CLIC Rule 81016755 & 81354683: When 5 or more physical PCIe cards are installed in DL380 Gen11, Primary Cable Kit P56073-B21 must be ordered to activate Slot 1 on Primary Riser P48803-B21.
familyGenRules.rawMessage: [CLIC RULE 81016755] Slot 1 of Primary Riser requires P56073-B21 Primary Cable Kit.

familyGenRules.ruleUpdate: When ordering Platinum PSUs (P38997-B21) on high-draw dual-socket configurations, P35876-B21 (CE Mark Removal Kit) is required for non-EU deployment, or upgrade to Titanium PSUs (P44712-B21).
familyGenRules.reasoning: EU Ecodesign Regulation 2019/424 (ErP Lot 9): High-draw dual-socket servers default to 96% Titanium PSUs. To deploy with Platinum PSUs (P38997-B21) outside the EU, P35876-B21 (CE Mark Removal FIO Enablement Kit) must be selected in Factory Configuration Settings.
familyGenRules.rawMessage: [CLIC LOT 9 RULE] This system does not meet EU Lot9 energy efficiency requirements. 96% efficient Titanium PSUs mandated, or select P35876-B21 CE Mark Removal Kit.
